name: Government ethics
definition: Rules and norms about how people who hold public power may use it, and who checks them.
scope: Conflicts of interest, disclosure, clemency, appointments and the limits on each. Electoral rules and campaign finance have their own topics.

name: Public office and private gain
definition: Whether, and how, the law should stop officeholders and their families from using an office to make money.
scope: Holdings and trading rules, family appointments, published tax returns and the reversal of pardons. Bribery statutes and lobbying rules belong to neighbouring topics.

name: Business & Economy
definition: Beliefs about how people trade, work, invest and are paid, and what the law should do about it.

name: Computers & Internet
definition: Beliefs about software, networks and the rules that govern them.

name: News & Media
definition: Beliefs about how news is made, paid for and trusted.

name: Entertainment
definition: Beliefs about film, music, humor and the industries behind them.

name: Recreation & Sports
definition: Beliefs about sport, travel, cars and the outdoors.

name: Health
definition: Beliefs about disease, treatment, fitness and the systems that deliver care.

name: Government
definition: Beliefs about how public power is won, held, used and checked.

name: Regional
definition: Beliefs that belong to one place: a country, a region, a state or a city.

name: Society & Culture
definition: Beliefs about people, communities, the environment and belief itself.

name: Education
definition: Beliefs about schools, universities and how people learn.

name: Arts & Humanities
definition: Beliefs about art, history, literature and philosophy.

name: Science
definition: Beliefs about what is known about the natural world and how.

name: Social Science
definition: Beliefs about how people behave, alone and together.

name: Reference
definition: Definitions, statistics and quotations the other topics rest on.
